description: The nodes of a scene file: names, classes and hierarchy, with properties when asked. Needs no editor. For the nodes of a running game, runtime_inspect tree. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads.

depth.description: Levels to descend, 0 being the root alone. Default: all.

includeDefaults.description: List every stored property, defaults included. A Control has about 80. Turns includeProperties on.

includeProperties.description: Include each node's properties that differ from a new node's. Default false.

name: scene_tree
title: Scene tree
